title: Saudi Arabia Family Visit Visa from the UK | UVS
description: Saudi family visit visa from the UK to visit relatives living in Saudi Arabia. 72-hour processing. We check your documents and apply for you.
h1: Saudi Arabia family visit visa from the UK
intro: The Saudi family visit visa lets you visit a relative who lives and works in Saudi Arabia. Your relative applies for the invitation in Saudi Arabia first, then we prepare and submit your visa application here in the UK.
eligibility: You have a close relative living in Saudi Arabia
Your relative has had a family visit invitation approved
You are visiting, not moving to live there

sections.heading: How the family visit visa works
sections.text: Your relative in Saudi Arabia requests a family visit invitation through the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Once it's approved, we apply for the visa in the UK with your documents. Processing usually takes about 72 hours.

sections.heading: British citizens: you may only need an ETA
sections.text: British passport holders can visit family on the [Saudi ETA](/saudi-arabia-eta-uk/) without an invitation. The family visit visa is mainly for other passport holders living in the UK.

sections.heading: Moving to live with your family
sections.text: If you're joining your family member to live in Saudi Arabia, you need a [Saudi residence visa](/saudi-residence-visa-uk/) instead.

sections.heading: Saudi family visit visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help families across the UK with Saudi family visit visas.

faqs.q: Who can invite me on a Saudi family visit visa?
faqs.a: A close relative who lives in Saudi Arabia on a residence permit (iqama), or a Saudi citizen.
Usually about 72 hours once the invitation is approved and your application is submitted.

prices.included: Family visit visa application completed and checked
